summary: Operator site (RoverPass-hosted, claimed booking) current. PRICE GATE DROP CANDIDATE: cheapest RV night $60 in every season tested (Jan and Jun 2027), no gateway within 40 km, not a Good Sam Park. Otherwise fine: Google 4.6/110, ~13 of 24 RV sites sold nightly plus 8 tent sites, year-round. Not waterfront stands (only tent sites riverside).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE - PRICE GATE (private): every RV site type sells at $60 a night before tax ('Full Hookup, 30 & 50 Amps, Back-In' and 'Pull-Thru', Daily $60 on the operator's rates page; RoverPass quotes $60 for one night on 2027-01-26, 01-30, 06-08 and 06-12; October 2026 had stopped taking same-season bookings). No cheaper RV night in any season. gateways.py: none within 40 km. Good Sam directory gs false (military true - a group discount, not a member discount); no operator-posted member discount. The weekly rate ($290, ~$41/night) is not a nightly rate. Stored fees were empty, so the sweep never priced it (RV Life tier $$).
LONG-STAY: 13 RV sites sold by the night, 11 more only on 10-/28-night rates, plus 8 tent sites = ~21 of ~32 nightly (~65%); Google 4.6 (110 reviews); recent reviews are overnight travellers. Passes.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' stands - the operator places only the tent sites 'alongside the Powder River'; RV sites are back from the river. (The site's amenity list tags 'Waterfront', which is the tent area.)
Site 14 is 22 ft (too short for a 23-ft rig); every other RV site is 42-70 ft.
Phone 307-738-2244 confirmed (site, RoverPass, Good Sam). Website https://www.powderrivercamping.com/ current; Google's website button points to a Hipcamp listing - not used.
Pin 43.70739,-106.63984 matches Google's point; Good Sam's 43.70805,-106.63944 is ~80 m off - no move.
Cabins: 3 rustic cabins beside ~24 RV sites - RV-first, not a cabin resort.
